runs.emptyBody: Once you export an agent to CI, every automated review shows up here.
runs.title: CI Runs
runs.subtitle: Agent reviews executed inside CI · not local runs

exportWizard.title: Export to CI
exportWizard.subtitle: Run {agentName} automatically on pull requests
exportWizard.repoHint: owner/name — the repo to add the workflow to
exportWizard.blockMergeDesc: Requires a GitHub App — not available with PAT in local mode
exportWizard.installCardTitle: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.
exportWizard.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs.

ciTab.heading: Continuous Integration
ciTab.subtitle: Run this agent automatically on pull requests in a target repo.
ciTab.empty: Not deployed to CI yet. Use “Publish to CI” to open a PR that adds the workflow + agent config.

publishDialog.title: Publish to CI
publishDialog.subtitle: Run {agentName} on every pull request in {repo}
publishDialog.intro: Opens a pull request in {repo} adding a GitHub Actions workflow + this agent's config under .devdigest/. On every PR the agent reviews the diff.
publishDialog.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs. GITHUB_TOKEN is provided automatically.
publishDialog.doneBody: Opened/updated a pull request in {repo} with the workflow + agent config.

empty.title: Not in CI yet
empty.body: Add this agent to CI to review every pull request automatically.

target.repoTaken: This repository is already wired to another agent ({agent}).
target.providerUnsupported: Only agents that use OpenRouter can be exported to CI.

preview.publicWarning: These files will be committed to the repository. Anyone with access to it can read them, so make sure they contain nothing private.

install.cardTitle: Open a PR with these files
install.cardBody: DevDigest opens a pull request in {repo} that adds the workflow and the agent config.
install.secretHint: Add OPENROUTER_API_KEY to the repository's Actions secrets before the workflow runs.

error.config: The export could not be generated for this agent. Check its configuration.
error.external: GitHub rejected the request. Check the repository access and try again.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
